title: Escape from New York
tagline: Get in. Get the President. Get dinner.
about: Snake Plissken has 24 hours to rescue the President from Manhattan, now a prison island.
cue: Serve the mains when the Duke rolls up in his chandelier car.
faces: NO WAY IN. NO WAY OUT.
Second watch eats first. The coffee runs all night, but nothing goes up to the consoles and nothing goes over the wall. Eat, then get back to it.
Security Control, one floor up. Trays stay down here.
Bottomless all night. Black or regular, hot.
Made with whole milk, for the cold river patrol.
Corn whiskey, fresh lemon and sugar, shaken, in a jar.
Top round soaked in soy and smoked paprika, dried in the oven.
Sardines in oil on crackers, lemon, hot sauce and parsley.
Buttery baked oats under dark chocolate and flaky salt.
Sliced peaches baked under a biscuit crust, served warm.
Smoked sausage, potato, white beans, tomato and cabbage.
Two thick slices, mashed potatoes, brown gravy and peas.
American on white, griddled, with a cup of tomato soup.
Prices subject to change. Trays to the rack.
USPF Form LI-1988. Liberty Island, N.Y. 1997.
phone:
The Watch MessEscape from New YorkIn and out, fed before time runs out.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersWall Watch JerkyTop round soaked in soy and smoked paprika, dried in the oven.Packs flat in a vest pocket.How to make it600g beef topside80ml soy sauce2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce2 tbsp brown sugar2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp chilli flakes1 tsp garlic powderFreeze the beef until firm.Slice 3mm thick across the grain and mix the marinade from the soy sauce, Worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, smoked paprika, chilli flakes and garlic powder.Marinate the beef in the marinade overnight in the fridge.Pat dry, lay on racks over trays and dry at 75°C with the oven door slightly open until leathery but still bendy.Tins and SaltinesSardines in oil on crackers, lemon, hot sauce and parsley.Eat them off the lid.How to make it220g tinned sardines in oil24 saltine crackers1 lemon1 tsp hot sauce1 small bunch parsleyDrain the sardines and chop the parsley.Lay a sardine on each cracker, squeeze over lemon, add a drop of hot sauce and some parsley. Serve on the tin lids.MainsThe Duke's StewSmoked sausage, potato, white beans, tomato and cabbage.Ladled into a mug for the wall crews.How to make it500g smoked sausage, sliced1 onion, diced2 carrots, diced600g potatoes, diced1 tsp smoked paprika400g tinned cannellini beans400g crushed tomatoes750ml chicken stock1/4 cabbage, shreddedsalt and pepper, to tasteDice the vegetables and slice the sausage. Shred the cabbage.Brown the sausage in a big pot, then add the onion, carrots and potatoes and cook.Add the paprika, beans, tomatoes and stock and simmer, adding the cabbage for the last 10 minutes.Season and serve in mugs.SweetsRation BarButtery baked oats under dark chocolate and flaky salt.For the chopper crews.How to make it150g butter3 tbsp golden syrup100g brown sugar250g rolled oats1 pinch salt150g dark chocolateflaky sea salt, to tasteMelt the butter with the golden syrup and sugar, stir in the oats and salt, and press firmly into a lined 20cm square tin.Bake at 180°C until golden.Melt the chocolate, spread over the warm slice and sprinkle with flaky salt.Cool, then chill until firm. Cut into 16 bars.DrinksWhite LightningCorn whiskey, fresh lemon and sugar, shaken, in a jar.Off watch only.How to make it240ml corn or white whiskey3 lemons2 tbsp caster sugar4 cups iceJuice the lemons and stir the sugar into the juice with a little warm water.Shake the whiskey with the lemon mix and ice, then strain into 4 ice-filled jam jars. Top up with lemonade and lemon for anyone not drinking.
